questions.text: Find the ratio in which rice at ₹8.30 per kg be mixed with rice at ₹5.30 per kg to produce a mixture worth ₹6.30 per kg.

P and Q can do a piece of work in 10, and 6 days, respectively, while R can destroy the same work in 15 days. If P and Q work on 1st day, R works on 2nd and so on. They follow the same pattern until the work gets completed. How many days will it take for the work to be completed the first time?

Baban has two grandsons Rakesh and Shivam. 13 year old Rakesh gets some money from Baban’s wealth and 14 year old Shivam gets rest of the money. But Rakesh and Shivam will get money only when they turn 22 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 10% compounded annually. When both turn 22, they receive the same amount. How much had Baban given Shivam (in ₹) initially, if total money with Baban was ₹23100?

Three persons step out together for a walk. Their steps measure 90 cm, 95 cm and 75 cm, respectively. What is the minimum distance (in m) each should walk so that they can cover the distance in complete step?
A scooterist is travelling at the speed of 42 km/h. How much distance (in km) will they travel in 90 minutes?
A man sold an article for ₹35,400 and made a profit of 18% in the process. What would have been his profit or loss percentage, had he sold it for ₹33,000?
The average weight of Amit, Gopal and Akshay is 45 kg. If the average weight of Amit and Gopal be 43 kg and that of Gopal and Akshay be 47 kg, then the weight of Gopal (in kg) is:
When 8, 16, 18, 20 and 25 divide the least number x, the remainder in each case is 3, but x is divisible by 7. What is the value of x?
The expenditure of Sudha is 175% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 12% and savings increase by 40.5%, then by what percent does her income increase?
The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹531 for a period of 5 years at the rate of 9% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
The height of a right circular cone is 10 cm and its base radius is 24 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm2) of the cone?
The population of a town increases by 8% annually. If the present population is 45,000, what will be its population after 2 years?
The third proportional of 20 and 25 is:
The present age ratio of the mother to the daughter is 7 : 2. After 12 years, their ages will be in the ratio of 9 : 4. What is the current age of the mother?
The marked price of a table is ₹8,980. If the shopkeeper offers a discount of 19%, what is its selling price (in ₹, to the nearest rupee)?
400 guavas were bought at ₹1240 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹940. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of guavas.
